landing.heroSubtitle: A simple daily check-in that keeps your closest connections at ease.
landing.step1Desc: One tap each day lets your loved ones know you're doing well.
landing.step2Desc: See at a glance who's checked in today across your circle.
landing.step3Desc: No news feeds, no pressure. Just quiet reassurance for the people who care.
landing.whyDesc: Life gets busy. A phone call feels like too much, a text gets lost in the noise. Pulse is the simplest way to say "I'm okay" to the people who matter most.
landing.featurePrivate: No social feed, no likes, no pressure
landing.featureFamily: Built for families and close friends
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join Pulse and give your loved ones peace of mind, one tap at a time.
